stepBody: Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' ').##figure2.gif##

figureAlts.figure2.gif: Tiffany has a bag with three marbles. One marble is orange, and the other two are purple. For each round of a game, she draws from the bag 10 times with replacement. She wins the round by drawing at least one orange marble. Write a function to simulate one round of Tiffany’s game. The function should return True if she wins and False if she loses. A fill-in-the-blank code block defining the function one_round. Inside the function: bag is assigned Blank 1, one_sim is assigned Blank 2, num_orange is assigned Blank 3, and the function returns Blank 4.
